story.title: BigEndian Semiconductors Raises $6M Led by IAN Alpha Fund to Commercialise Its First System-on-Chip
story.summary: Indian semiconductor startup BigEndian Semiconductors has secured $6 million in funding led by IAN Alpha Fund, with the capital earmarked to commercialise its first system-on-chip product, expand its product engineering team, and deepen partnerships with foundries, IP ecosystems, and OEMs. The raise is notable in the context of India's push to build a domestic semiconductor industry, as BigEndian represents a rare homegrown chip design company reaching commercial readiness. The investment also reflects growing domestic venture confidence in India's semiconductor ambitions following recent government fab approvals.
use_cases: SoC development for Indian OEM supply chains
